parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page during paging. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPC to which the route table belongs.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the route table belongs.

parameters.name: RouteTableId
parameters.description:
The ID of the route table to query.

>You must specify at least one of the following parameters: **VRouterId**, **RouteTableId**, **RouterId**, and **RouteTableName**. You cannot specify both **VRouterId** and **RouterId**.

parameters.name: RouteTableName
parameters.description:
The name of the route table to query.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

>You must specify at least one of the following parameters: **VRouterId**, **RouteTableId**, **RouterId**, and **RouteTableName**. You cannot specify both **VRouterId** and **RouterId**.

parameters.name: RouterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the router to which the route table belongs.

>You must specify at least one of the following parameters: **VRouterId**, **RouteTableId**, **RouterId**, and **RouteTableName**. You cannot specify both **VRouterId** and **RouterId**.

parameters.name: RouterType
parameters.description:
The type of the router to which the route table belongs. Valid values:

- **VRouter** (default): vRouter.
- **VBR**: Virtual Border Router.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the route entry to query. Valid values:

- **Custom**: custom route.
- **System**: system route.
- **BGP**: BGP route.
- **CEN**: Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) route.
- **ECR**: Express Connect Router (ECR) route.

parameters.name: VRouterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the vRouter to query.

>You must specify at least one of the following parameters: **VRouterId**, **RouteTableId**, **RouterId**, and **RouteTableName**. You cannot specify both **VRouterId** and **RouterId**.
